mechanism: Amphetamine's sympathomimetic effects (increased heart rate, blood pressure, cardiac workload) may counteract benazepril's antihypertensive and cardioprotective benefits, while benazepril theoretically provides some compensatory vasodilation.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative ADHD medications or dose adjustment of benazepril; counsel patient on stimulant use risk with ACE inhibitors.
